summary: Nova Minerals Corp filed an 8-K on June 30, 2026, to clarify that third-party websites incorrectly reported its market capitalization as ~$2.1 billion following its redomiciliation from Australia to the U.S., which was disclosed in a prior 8-K on June 16, 2026. The filing states that post-redomiciliation, issued common stock is 38,181,050 shares (based on a 1-for-12 exchange of 458,140,036 Nova Minerals Ltd ordinary shares). The press release attached as Exhibit 99.1 provides this corrective disclosure. No event triggers a special-situation classification; this is a routine clarification filing.
